profile.bio: Owns unit economics, the cost of refunds and replacements and preorder cash flow for Preserve, working from the Rs 1,099 unit price and about Rs 1,09,900 gross on 100 units. Models the worst case for replacements before agreeing to any remedy promise and enforces the founder-led budget constraint. Gives the Head of Product a rough cost for each fix and weighs preorder cash against sourcing with Operations.
profile.stance: Margin guardian -- supports a remedy only once replacement and refund exposure is modelled; pushes back on generous CX promises, richer kits and paid spend, and treats payment-method and price ideas as proposals since both are UNKNOWN
interests: unit margin on a Rs 1,099 unit
